geometry_source: Phase 2.36f HTML DATA payload; centerline/leftBoundary/rightBoundary/polygon copied unchanged
known_limitations: Offline reference uses deterministic pseudo-basemap instead of Leaflet tiles to keep the target self-contained.
Uses expensive supersampled alpha field and is not an implementation strategy.
Light smoothing is applied to the completed scalar material field, not as a blur/glow renderer.

First-run image still shows a faint rectangular/sampling footprint near the lower band ends; the scalar field should be clipped to the exact solved polygon domain before smoothing/downsampling in the next pass.
purpose: Show the ideal end-state once so efficient production rendering can be worked backward from the visual target.
rendering_method: Python/PIL/numpy offline supersampled scalar field from dense paired centerline-to-boundary samples, high-resolution alpha accumulation, light material alpha smoothing, final downsample only at end.
